FOR TESTERS

Take part in tests that shape what gets built.

Apply once and join a reviewed pool of people who test products and ideas. You choose whether to accept each invitation.

Apply now
I am a founder
Before you apply
What you will do

Tasks are short — usually 10 to 30 minutes. You might try a prototype, walk through a real situation or answer a focused set of questions. Then you write a short account of what happened.

What you get

Every invitation states the task, the time and the reward before you accept. There is no charge to join. Applying does not guarantee a paid task.

How selection works

The team reviews applications within three business days. Approved testers are invited when their situation and interests match a founder’s question. It is not first come, first served.

Your privacy

Your name, email and phone number are used to run the pilot. Founders receive counts and anonymised responses. Your account shows the reward status for every completed test.

Tester questions

Request your invite

Apply to join RAPID's tester pool. It takes about three minutes. We aim to review applications within three business days.

Applying does not guarantee a test or payment.
